subject: Renewal: Dedicated pool + throughput increase — credit approval requested
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Teresa Nguyen <t.nguyen@aurorahealth.io>, Mark Patel <m.patel@aurorahealth.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal proposal: reserved A100 pool + throughput uplift

Hi Teresa / Mark —

Thanks for the conversation last week. Attached is renewal proposal v3 that rolls the Dedicated reservation into a 12‑month term and includes the additional reserved capacity we discussed: +8 A100 GPUs (reserved pool), a throughput commitment of 2.5M tokens/day, and a 1.5x burst window during peak hours. Key points: 

- Base committed spend: $186,000/mo (12 mo)
- Additional reserved GPUs: 8x A100 (q4 pinned start on renewal)
- Target throughput SLO: 95th percentile latency < 220ms for 512-token requests

We included the proposed technical notes for node placement and a suggested canary plan. See attachment: Aurora_Renewal_Proposal_v3.pdf (PDF).

Let me know if you want this on the standard renewal terms or if procurement will request a one‑time credit for expansion. If so, give me a target credit %, and I will route for approvals.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Teresa Nguyen <t.nguyen@aurorahealth.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 Nov 2025 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: reserved A100 pool + throughput uplift

Marissa —

Thanks for the proposal. The architecture team is comfortable with the sizing. Procurement is pushing back on the month‑over‑month increase without a concession. They're asking whether Redwood can offer a one‑time onboarding credit or an expansion discount to offset the first two months of the additional reserved GPUs — target ask: 20% off the first 2 months of the incremental spend.

If you can make that work, we can get legal ready and try to sign before Dec 1.

— Teresa
Sr. Procurement Manager, Aurora HealthTech
[signature omitted]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 05 Nov 2025 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal proposal: credit request from Aurora (20% ask)

Team — FYI, Aurora (large strategic healthcare account) is asking for a one‑time credit equivalent to 20% of the incremental cost for the first two months of the new reserved GPUs. Numbers below: incremental monthly for the 8 GPUs = $48,000/mo; 20% x 2 months ~= $19,200 ask.

We are at renewal and they'd sign quickly if we can meet them on this. Requesting guidance: do we have flexibility to approve up to 15% from AE budget or do we need exec finance signoff for anything >15%?

Attachments: Aurora_Renewal_Proposal_v3.pdf

Thanks — Marissa
[internal thread]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 05 Nov 2025 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal proposal: credit request from Aurora (20% ask)

Marissa —

Aurora is strategic; retention + expansion priority is high. Our standard playbook: AEs can approve up to 10% promotional or onboarding credits without finance/exec signoff. Anything between 10–15% needs manager sign‑off; >15% requires formal finance/BD exec approval and a revenue commit (12M+ preferred).

Proposal: offer 12% one‑time credit on the incremental spend for the first two months (total credit ~$11,520) contingent on a 12‑month renewal with quarterly usage reviews and a committed uplift clause. If Aurora pushes back, escalate to aditya for exec approval.

Vivek
VP, Sales Operations
[internal]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 06 Nov 2025 14:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal proposal: credit request from Aurora (20% ask)

Team —

Finance is ok to provisionally approve up to 12% as a one‑time onboarding/expansion concession for strategic renewals, on the condition that legal signs the amendment with the committed spend language (12 months, minimum monthly commitment), and we capture usage telemetry for the first 90 days. Anything >12% will need aditya/Head of Sales signoff and a short memo showing the expected ARR uplift vs. concession.

If Marissa pushes this to aditya for >12% approval, please include the hubspot deal link and the proposed DocuSign amendment for quicker routing.

Tessa
Director, Revenue Finance
[internal]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Hi Teresa / Mark —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Good news: Redwood can extend a one‑time 12% onboarding credit on the incremental reserved GPU cost for the first two months. I attached the updated quote (Aurora_Updated_Quote_20251110.xlsx) and a DocuSign link for the amendment. If that looks good, Teresa, we can route to your legal and aim to sign before Dec 1.
